content:
[L] high | bottom composer strip | the composer panel overlaps the reading pane: a clipped message bubble is visibly cut off behind the composer's top edge at the "2026-02-16" divider, so conversation content runs beneath the reply area.
[L] high | right side of screen above composer | the "Copilot" tab and status controls float with no panel behind them and sit on a different grid than the "Conversation" card, which extends further right than the composer below it — the two panels' right edges are misaligned.
[L] med | composer strip | the composer spans only the reading-pane width while the Copilot header controls span wider, producing two inconsistent right-edge alignments in the same vertical band.
[S] high | conversation list | row 4 (#504) has visibly larger internal spacing than rows 1–3; the unassigned row's "Unassigned" italic label and "Active" chip sit on a taller row than the identical assignee rows, breaking rhythm.
[S] med | views rail vs list | the "All" heading in the list column and the "Views" label in the rail are not baseline-aligned; the rail items are vertically centered in their hitboxes while list rows are top-aligned.
[S] med | Conversation card | the Assignee dropdown and the Assign button are separated by a different gap than the Status chip group and Priority chip group above/below them; each field row has its own arbitrary spacing.
[S] med | toolbar row | "Filters", "Reset", and "Sync now" are scattered across the row with inconsistent gaps — Filters/Reset are grouped left with a large gap, Sync now is pushed right with a floating search "#" box between search field and Apply.
[S] low | search row | the "#" tag-filter button is wider than needed and its height does not match the search input's height exactly.
[H] high | list rows | customer name, timestamp, ticket subject, assignee avatar, and status chip all render at near-identical weight/size, so metadata competes equally with the primary subject line.
[H] med | Conversation card | field labels (Status, Assignee, Priority, State, Tags, Snooze) are same-size plain gray text with no hierarchy, and the Snooze row mixes a label with unstyled raw text links ("2h tomorrow 3d") unlike every other control row.
[H] med | composer | "reply — sent to the customer · Ctrl+Enter sends" hint text sits at same visual weight as labels and is bottom-left while Send is bottom-right, leaving no grouping of related footer content.
[C] high | mid reading pane | a large dead zone exists between the Conversation card and the date divider — an empty band plus the clipped bubble behind the composer wastes vertical space while the conversation thread itself is crushed off-screen.
[C] med | three-column layout | the views rail is extremely wide for six short labels, the list column and reading pane proportions are unbalanced, and no visible separators delineate the three columns, making regions bleed together.
[C] med | top-right controls | "Copilot" (icon+label), a bare circle icon, and the Active pill are three unrelated control styles floating on one row with inconsistent spacing and no container.
[C] low | list column | date-only divider "2026-02-16" in the reading pane is centered with hairline rules, a different visual treatment than any other divider in the app.
VERDICT: unprofessional — overlapping panels, clipped content, and inconsistent spacing/typography throughout read as a debug mockup, not a shippable helpdesk product.
